description: Measured trees and woods of doningtonpark (measure_runoff.py; derived data): canopy over 3 m (DSM - DTM, and vegetation classes where the point cloud has them). woods: polygons (recipe grid, simplified 3 m) of 5 m cells at least half covered, with their mean cover; trees: single trees and small clumps outside the woods (grid e, n and canopy height m), at least 6 m apart.
sources: Environment Agency National LIDAR Programme point cloud (intensity, classification, heights); Open Government Licence v3.0; Contains Environment Agency information (c) Environment Agency and/or database right
